Submeshes are contiguous in triangle and vertex order in intact files, but the boundaries cannot be read back, so these models are refused (importer.LostMaterialLayer).

entries.where: t_mro_* / t_mroe_* on every lobby Pokémon material
entries.hypothesis: R metallic, G roughness, B occlusion, A emission/mask; repacked to glTF ORM. VERIFIED 2026-11-09 against the decompiled shaders (header `_MixMap ("MROE")`): basepbr_lv3.txt:468-480 (B pow _AOScale on ambient/env only = scope indirect), Cloth_lv3.txt:2998 (unpowered B on SH ambient), Battle actorbase_lv3.txt:849 (B multiplies the whole result = scope total). Exposed as extras.unite.ao {scope, power}.

entries.where: t_mroe_* alpha
entries.hypothesis: VERIFIED 2026-11-09: emission = albedo.rgb x A x scale x colour, added to the lit result. basepbr family: scale = _Emissive x _EmisssionScale, no colour (basepbr_lv3.txt:479-480, :739). LobbyPokemon basepbrCloth_lv3 only: scale = _Emiss (float; the JSON's _Emissive is stale), colour = _EmissColor.rgb HDR (Cloth_lv3.txt:3035-3041, :3355). Battle actorbase_lv3: _Emissive x _EmisssionScale x _EmisssionColor, added after the AO product (:844-849). With Cloth _EMISSMASK + _IFRAMP/_IFMAT the same alpha is the ramp/matcap mask (maskKind matcapMask; emission left off). A also follows R in many files (Zacian A = R/2): those only glow where an author set a scale > 0.
entries.notes: Baked by unite/emission.py into an emissive texture (albedo x A, sRGB) + factor/KHR_materials_emissive_strength; extras.unite.emission/maskKind. Survey: 679 JSON materials emit (A varies on 553, flat 255 on 92 = uniform albedo glow at the authored scale, 0 on 25, no mix file 6), 67 are EMISSMASK. FBX-only materials have no params: every family default is _Emissive 0, so off.

entries.where: basepbrCloth_lv3 with _EMISSMASK 1 and _IFRAMP/_IFMAT (64 materials)
entries.hypothesis: The Inspector label says the alpha then masks the ramp/matcap and cannot emit, but the compiled code still adds `A x _EmissColor x _Emiss x albedo` in those variants (Cloth_lv3.txt:24231, :27578). Emission is left off there (matches the label; _EmissColor on them is a grey a=0 swatch).
entries.notes: Both ways are one switch in emission.emission_params.

entries.where: eye materials (name contains 'eye'): base colour sheets 128x128 .. 1024x1024 next to the eye mesh UVs
entries.hypothesis: The rip has NO eye animation: FBX clips hold only Lcl T/R/S curves (0 of 1508 FBX carry BlendShape/DeformPercent/UV curves; Unity material _MainTex_ST curves are not in the AssetStudio export; lobby face bones are static). The expression sheets are grids of cells (Pikachu battle 2x2, Venusaur lobby 2x4, a pure-red cell = unused) and the mesh UVs sit on one cell, so importer.eye_variants exposes the other non-blank cells as an `eyes` variant group (KHR_texture_transform offsets). Grid = power-of-two divisions holding the largest UV island; alternatives = the occupied block shifted by whole spans. Refinement 2026-11-01: the UV island only gives a lower bound for the cell size (Lapras lobby: eye mesh fills 1/8 of the height of a 1/4-high cell, which gave 2x8 and half-cell duds), so importer._atlas_grid picks the finest grid <= that bound whose cell borders cut no drawn content (GRID_CUT_MAX, FITTED). Red marker cells are near-red (96% exact), so they are detected by >90% pure red.
entries.notes: Cell meaning (angry, blink, sleepy...) is not in the data; options are labelled Eyes N. Surveyed 1,147 converted eye materials: mostly 2x2 (128), 2x4 (256x512, 512x1024), some 4x4 (512+).

entries.where: battle clips: rotation tracks on Jaw_ACC / Bone_Jaw / Bone_RootJaw / UpperJaw / LowerJaw
entries.hypothesis: Battle idle/run clips hold the jaw 8-19 deg open (Ninetales Jaw_ACC bind Rz 112, idle 122-129); lobby clips have no jaw track so the jaw rests at bind. Treated as a rest-pose artefact: jaw rotation tracks that stay within 25 deg (JAW_REST_MAX_DEG, FITTED) of bind are dropped. Could instead be an intended panting/open-mouth idle.
entries.notes: Survey 2026-11-01: 234 of 309 battle models with jaw/mouth/tongue bones animate them in idle; 64 hold >= 5 deg open (histogram 0-5: 145, 5-10: 41, 10-15: 20, 15-20: 6, 20-25: 18, more: 3). mouthAtlas: 430 mouth materials with expression sheets (2x4 256x512 148, 2x2 128x128 136, ...), handled by atlas_variants.

entries.where: APK jp.pokemon.pokemonunite 1.24.1.1 split_ab.apk assets/Main/*.bundle (1484), config zips, CDNUpload/*.bytes
entries.hypothesis: The scene light rig (main/add light colour + direction, ambient SH, reflection cubemap, post-processing) is not in any readable file: the APK's plain files (start-up scenes, settings, UI) hold none of it, and the MEGA AssetStudio export has no Light/RenderSettings data either.
entries.notes: Presets are fitted to in-game footage instead (tools/lightrefs, refs/unite/). Readable class list (globalgamemanagers.assets MonoScripts, 2026-11-01) names the stack: URP ForwardRenderer; renderer features PerObjectBloom/PerObjUBuffEffectPass, MobilePostProcessLwrp, CustomLighting2; shaders RenderFeatures/Outline, Pass2Outline, SpecialOutline, FakeShadow; Bakery lightmaps; Volume Bloom + ShadowsMidtonesHighlights; QualitySettings 2 pixel lights, shadow distance 40. No published TiMi/UNITE rendering talk found.

entries.where: ghostGlass _RampMap; FBX-only: (a) no texture links + a translucent matcap named after the material, t_matcap_[bat_|lob_]<dex><skin><letter>[_lv3] (letterless fallback); (b) DiffuseColor only, no Bump, albedo alpha under its own UVs < 16 -> glass image = a translucent square texture in its own block; (c) a material whose only colour source is a matcap (Litwick line fire: DiffuseColor -> t_matcap_)
entries.hypothesis: UPDATED 2026-11-09: ghostGlass (lobby; dump lines 192-239) alpha = clamp(_Cutoff*clamp(k*Bot.a + c.a) - NoV, 0, 1) (transparent face-on, opaque at grazing angles), NoV = min(|N.V|+.004,1), k = clamp(1 - clamp((NoV-_ShadowOffset)*_ShadowPow) + main.a), c = matcap(uv + k*_ShadowScale) x mix(_SHTopColor,_SHBotColor,k), rgb = c.rgb + _Cutoff*main.rgb. Battle actorglass (dump lines 199-217): alpha = clamp((k + c.a)*_CustomAlpha), k = 1 - clamp((NoV-_RoughNessOffset)*_EmisssionScale), uv offset _MetallicOffset, rgb = c.rgb*1.2. Written as extras.unite.glass (constants from the JSON, else the Properties defaults 0/2/1/2.5/1); viewer scene/matcap.ts. Selection of glass among FBX-only materials is unchanged (rules a, b below); a matcap linked as DiffuseColor (Litwick fire, rule c) keeps the older matcap-alpha look (info.matcapAsDiffuse) since its shader is unknown. Not drawn: the _GhostMap dissolve (_GhostChange 0 on all four JSONs), lights other than colour 1.
entries.notes: Rule (b) threshold is FITTED (CLEAR_ALBEDO_ALPHA). Gengar 01 lobby's JSON says ghostGlass with the same FBX signature as (b). FBX-only glass is 'actor' kind when the material name has _bat_, else 'ghost'; both inferred.

entries.where: Cluster TransformLink per (mesh, bone): meshes sharing a bone may disagree (29 weighted meshes in 18 of 1,508 FBX by > 1 mm, ~20 by >= 5 cm; plus 4 weightless)
values: all 24 clusters include its mesh node's +1.545 m x offset; outfit's do not
entries.hypothesis: Unity keeps bindposes per SkinnedMeshRenderer: vertex = bone(t) @ inv(TL_own) @ meshWorld @ v. fbx_anim keeps one bind per bone (last cluster read won), so such meshes were torn. importer.apply_mesh_binds: bake R = K @ inv(TL_own) into the vertices when R is the same for every bone the mesh uses, else Mesh.inverse_binds -> an extra glTF skin. Verified on rest and idle bounds (Miraidon 03 body x +-0.80 inside the outfit at idle; was split 1.5 m to the side).
entries.notes: Supersedes the CLAUDE.md claim that every TransformLink equals its bone's Lcl rest world (true per mesh, not across meshes).

entries.where: Connections: each Material's OP texture links are followed by the Texture<->Video links of the textures it introduced (fbx.material_blocks)
entries.hypothesis: AssetStudio writes textures as the concatenation, over the Materials in Objects order, of each material's m_TexEnvs (deduplicated at first use; keys alphabetical): verified exactly on 303 of 325 scene FBXs with JSONs. Only _MainTex/_BumpMap are linked. fbx.material_blocks/assign_blocks: a linked material's run follows its OP links; textures before the first OP link belong to the leading unlinked materials; within a run a texture goes to the unlinked material it is named after exactly (or loosely when it does not also name the linked one), else to the linked material while it is a character kind (n, mro, vc, matcap, ramp), else to the unlinked material being written (INFERRED when several share a run). An unlinked material's colour slot = its first non-character texture, one named after it first (_Tex1 sorts first in 87% of Fx JSONs). The global default t_fx_0196_color_01_cj (821 of 878 battle folders) is skipped.
entries.notes: Round 1 dropped the leading run and the spill: 175 of 199 'effect without texture' primitives in 68 models had their textures in the file (Charmander's tail flame, Gastly 10, Mega Charizard X, Charizard 16...).

entries.where: mro R (metallic) + the material's matcap (JSON _MatCapTex/_MatTex/_MatMap/_RampTex(t_matcap_), FBX block t_matcap_*), else the generic env `t_mipmap03` (JSON `_MatcapTex`)
values: Zacian lobby bodya gold matcap gain
entries.hypothesis: SUPERSEDED by the decompiled shaders (Assets/Shaders/Compiled): 'matcap' is four terms. matTex (Cloth _IFMAT: matcap x (0.25+0.75 N.L) x _MatTexColor, additive, independent of metal; basepbrCloth dump lines 9640-9653), rampLight (_IFRAMP: ramp(min(NoV^2,.96)*ST.x+ST.z) x same light x _RampTexColor; 5855-5876), env (Cloth _Matcap = _MATCAPENV_ON: matcap(lod r(1.7-.7r)6) x light x _MatcapColor x F0 x AO, F0 = mix(.04, albedo, metal), NO Schlick; 49852-49881; Lengcy/MatcapMask _IF_MATREFL: x _MatMapMul/(r^4+1) x mix(F0, grazing, (1-NoV)^4); battle actorMatcap: matcap x _SpecularColor), bubble (unlit albedo+matcap). The 1/luminance gain and its 0.15 floor are gone; `_MATREFL` on a Cloth JSON (60) is not a Cloth property and does nothing; `_RampTex` is not a matcap. Written as extras.unite.{matTex,rampLight,env}; viewer scene/matcap.ts. Additive terms carry the shaders' 0.45 exposure (Cloth line 9700).
entries.notes: GAPS: without the keyword the shader samples the scene reflection probe (unity_SpecCube0), not in the rip: those materials get metal factor 0. FBX-only materials carry no keywords: a Cloth block's own t_matcap_ is read as _MatTex (219 of 357 Cloth JSONs naming a t_matcap_ have _IFMAT with it in _MatTex), colour = shader default 2.0; a MatcapMask/Lengcy block matcap as env with _MatMapMul 4.84 (17 of 23 JSON materials with a _MatMap have _MATREFL on; their _MatMapMul is 1.0/1.57/2.27/4.84); battle actorMatcap env with _SpecularColor 1. All tagged inferred. N.L uses the viewer's key light without shadow; light colour taken as 1; the shader's ACES is the viewer's own tone mapping. Old GLBs keep extras.matcap/matcapMode/matcapGain, still read by the viewer. | previous notes: Shader not in the rip (character shaders are only in the game's asset bundles). _MetallicOffset/_RoughNessOffset ~0 (metal = texture), _IFMatcap always 0. Charizard 17's lobby jacket texture is darker than battle (sRGB median 17 vs 34): it stays dark. Survey 2026-11-08 (382 lobby materials naming a matcap with a decodable image): _MatcapColor (R) does NOT compensate dark matcaps: corr(matcap mean  | 2026-11-09 fix: FBX-only keyword terms apply only when the shader's Properties default has them on (families.default_params: Cloth _IFMAT 0, Lengcy/MatcapMask _MATREFL 0), so no inferred matTex/env; the keyword statistics (219/357 Cloth t_matcap_ with _IFMAT; 17/23 _MatMap with _MATREFL) are only the reason a default may be wrong for some materials. Battle actorMatcap has no toggle, its term stays. No term = metal factor 0 (albedo shows).

entries.where: LayerElementColor of effect meshes (fbx.mesh_vertex_colours)
entries.hypothesis: Unity Fx shaders multiply their greyscale masks by the vertex colour; FBX-only effect materials take their mesh's mean vertex colour as the emissive factor (alpha x its alpha). The masks alone rendered white. Lit character meshes carry shader data in the same layer (Fuecoco's tuft 0.91/0.46/0.91, bodies ~0.4-0.9/0.1-0.5/0-0.4): not used as colour.
entries.notes: Mean per mesh, not per vertex (the Blender dump drops vertex colours); effect meshes are near-uniform. Survey 2026-11-01 (464 effect mesh/material records, all 1,508 FBX): no colour ramp exists for Fx masks (the Fx shaders have no ramp slot: _Tex1-3/_Dtex/_DistorbTex x HDR _Color1 x _Emission1/_Power1/_Alpha1 x vertex colour); t_fx_0196_color_01_cj is a flat purple 64x64 global default byte-identical in 827 folders, linked by nothing. Effect meshes have 1 UV set. 144 of 330 vertex-coloured effect meshes vary within the mesh (Charizard 16 fxA 0.20-0.91), which the mesh mean discards: per-vertex COLOR_0 would be exact but needs vertex colours in blender/dump_fbx.py (not done). A whole-mesh (0.502, 0.502, 0.502) is an untouched default. ~69 textured effects (grey mask, no or neutral vertex colour) have no colour source in the rip. Skeledirge battle flames already get (0.788, 0.447, 0.071); they render as fragments because their textures are sparse masks (ember specks, flame-shape atlas) the game scrolls.

entries.where: effect materials with no texture link, no texture block, no sibling slot to borrow from
entries.hypothesis: Textures not in the rip (grep over MEGA + Drive). User decision 2026-11-01: imported HIDDEN as `<mesh>~notex` with a neutral untextured material (`extras.missingTexture`), switchable in Model Parts. A texture-less slot on the same mesh as a textured one borrows that colour texture when >= 90% of its UVs land on drawn texels (Crocalor's head flame ring: 94% on the orange half).
entries.notes: 33 of them have FBX Specular != AssetStudio's 0.2 default (lit shader): Fuecoco, Skeledirge lobby, Vulpix/Ninetales fx, Mewtwo trails, Sylveon, Gabite, Reshiram.

entries.where: idle effect prefabs `pref_fx_*` whose subtree holds only Null nodes (`huo 1`, `CTFIre (5)`, `glow`)
entries.hypothesis: Unity ParticleSystems: AssetStudio's FBX export writes only mesh renderers, so the emitters are empty GameObjects. Nothing in the MEGA tree, the Drive share, or the plain files of the APK (0 ParticleSystem objects; the effect components are KriptoFX RFX4 + ParticleRenderCtrl, in encrypted bundles). Emitter subtrees carry no curves in any clip (static children of a body bone). Manifest `extras.particlesNotInRip` + `extras.particles` (nearest kept bone, rest offset, subtreeScale, HOME colours) for the viewer stand-in.

entries.where: Battle FBX AnimationStack names `ani_<clip>_bat_<tag>`; tag = species (`0025`), skin (`002513`) or form (`0150_51`, `0130_51`)
entries.hypothesis: A skin is an AnimatorOverrideController over its form's base controller: its FBX carries only the clips authored for it (tagged with the skin), the rest are the base set. Evidence (survey of 878 battle FBXs, 2026-11-01): many full skins embed the base set verbatim (Pikachu 02/03/08/10/11 = 19 x `0025`), some mix both (Pikachu 22: 15 base + 4 own; Comfey 01: 11 + 16), Pikachu 18 embeds skin 13's overrides, and 29 skins ship 1-16 clips with no idle/attacks (Pikachu 13: born/goback/score/scoreidle; Eevee 18: score). importer.inherit_base_clips samples the form's skin-00 FBX (catalog unite_battle.skin_keys: same prefix/dex/form letter/name, case-insensitive) onto the skin's joints by path, values verbatim (Unity applies curve values absolutely), own clips win by name or by a one-letter misspelling (akt1/atk1, spll1/spell1). Gate: >= 90% of the donor's keyed LimbNodes on the skin's rig.
entries.notes: Tags cannot pick the donor alone: Urshifu A and B styles both tag `0892` with different sets, Comfey `p_` and plain both tag `0764`. Forms are NOT chained to the species' skin 00: Mega Charizard Y `0006_52` (10 clips, 22 of 58 joints shared with 0006_00) and Mega Lucario `0448_51` (18 clips) keep their own clips; Mega Charizard X `0006_51` embeds 17 base `0006` clips itself, which suggests the forms do inherit the base too, unproven on a different rig. Where a skin's bind differs from the base (Talonflame 02, Machamp 05), base translation tracks pull its bones to the base offsets, as Unity would.

TailA04 (V~0); _LerpTex top row (Unity V=1, profile 0 = _BaseColor red-orange) therefore lies at the TIP and the bottom row (profile 1 = _LayerColor yellow) at the ROOT, assuming the shader samples _LerpTex by mesh UV (shader not in rip). entries.where: marcy Assets/Shaders/Compiled/==PGAME==_Fx_m_*.txt, _Fx2_m_bat_FXmesh_lv3.txt
entries.hypothesis: Decompiled Fx shaders share one output: rgb = tex1.rgb x _Emission1 x _Color1.rgb x vertexColor.rgb (m_1P_Base also ^_Power1), alpha = tex1.a x vertexColor.a x [dissolve smoothstep(tex2.r; _DissolveOffset1, _DissolveEdge1)] x _Alpha1; _IF_ADD_MODE multiplies rgb by that alpha (additive) else straight; UVs = uv x _texN_st + fract(time x _TexN_Speed). The importer's vertex-colour tint matches this formula. Not recoverable from FBX-only materials: shader name, `_Color1`/`_Emission1`/`_Alpha1`, speeds and which block texture is the dissolve/noise map (two-texture blocks fit m_2P_mask and m_2P_dissolve alike). `Fx2/m_bat_FXmesh_lv3` (the only Fx shader with `_MainTex`) is lit PBR with alpha = tex.a x `_CustomAlpha` and no vertex colour, but a DiffuseColor link does NOT identify it: Mega Y's fire_76 (vertex-tinted, verified) and Moltres' noise maps are linked too, so Skeledirge keeps the vertex tint.

entries.where: FBX-only materials (battle models, standalone lobby holowears): no Materials/*.json, so no m_Shader.Name
entries.hypothesis: extras.unite.family (familyInferred true) = families.infer_family(material name, texture block, kind). Rules: name `fx` token -> fx; t_nm_ -> player; eye/mouth in the name -> basepbreye/basepbrmouth; t_noise -> fur; own t_matcap_ + t_mipmap03 -> cloth; body + own matcap + t_mroe -> matcapMask; t_ramp (no t_m_) -> cloth; outfit with t_fx_changeskin and no mroe/matcap -> lengcy; other outfit cloth; else basepbr. Battle models: actorbase (actorMatcap with an own matcap, actorbaseeye/actorbasemouth by name; NOT validated, no battle JSON exists). Calibrated on 726 distinct lobby scene materials that have JSONs (tools/calibrate_unite_families.py): 84.5% on the character families (90.1% with cloth/lengcy/matcapMask merged; per token recall eye 1.00, mouth 1.00, cloth 0.95, basepbr 0.87, fur 0.72, lengcy 0.44, player 0.41, matcapMask 0.24); leave-one-out signature-majority baseline 86.7% on the same set, so the rules are not memorising. Cloth, Lengcy and ClothMatcapMask read the same inputs and cannot be separated by a block (CLOTH_GROUP). Counts for FBX-only materials (3251 battle + 2689 lobby): battle actorbase 1389, actorbaseeye 892, actorMatcap 530, actorbasemouth 338, fx 102; lobby cloth 797, basepbr 707, basepbreye 615, basepbrmouth 212, matcapMask 132, lengcy 84, fx 65, fur 59, player 18.

entries.hypothesis: Lit = lightColour(NdL d + spec) + d(Atop SHTop + Abot SHBot)SHScale, d = albedo(1-metal), spec = min(D,100)(0.25+0.25r) F0 NdL SpecularColor with D = (a/((a x)^2+1-x^2))^2, a = r^2, x = N.V (lobby: the shader feeds N.V into its N.H slot) or N.H (battle); battle light colour x1.2 clamped 1.2; AO: lobby indirect, battle total. basepbr (non-fur variants) assumed to share Cloth's form (the dumped first variant is the fur one). The rim and main light (_RimlightScale/Scale2/ShadowScale/Color, _RimLightDir, _MainLightColor) sit in the shader's GLOBAL constant buffer (Cloth :860-880 next to _AddLightDir/_SunShift): scripted per scene, not in the rip, so the JSON rim values never reach the GPU; only the fur shaders (Hidden/Lobby/m_lob_basepbr5pass) declare the rim as Properties but still lack Scale2 and the direction.

entries.hypothesis: A texture-less UNITE part (`missingTexture`: Fuecoco/Crocalor tuft, Skeledirge lobby flames) has a counterpart in the same species' HOME model (user decision 2026-11-09: HOME is the fallback for UNITE effect colours). Both models are scaled by their larger horizontal extent about the model origin (a bbox bottom/centre was thrown off by stray HOME meshes: Skeledirge BirdB hangs 1.2 m below the floor). The part's HOME mesh = the opaque HOME mesh nearest to it that is NOT the UNITE body skin (share of its vertices within 0.02 of the UNITE body <= 0.7: body skins 0.8-1.0, tufts/crowns 0.15-0.6; Charizard's glow shells hugging the body are rejected). Each part vertex takes the HOME texel (x base colour) at its nearest vertex of that mesh as COLOR_0 on a lit material `<name>.home`. Gate: mean match distance <= 0.06 and >= 90% of vertices within 0.10. Part positions are the raw bind positions unless their extent is > 1.5x the body's (mesh-space scale: Fuecoco skin 01's tuft is 38x), then rest-skinned. INFERRED: HOME form 00 for every UNITE form; per-vertex nearest sampling blurs HOME's thin orange rim. Fuecoco skin 01 (tuft tilted in the FBX rest pose, d 0.09) fails the gate and stays a hidden ~notex part. 2026-11-10: a part may match several HOME meshes together (each vertex takes the nearest of any candidate; Skeledirge's lobby `fx_lv004` = BirdA+B+C, cover 0.78 -> 1.0), and sparse-texture parts (fx:borrowCoverage) are candidates too.

entries.hypothesis: HOME effect shaders hold no speed property; the looping idle clip (`*_loop01`) ramps `_materialModifiers` helper transforms bound to `Blend0/1UVTranslate`, `Mask0/1UVTranslate` (fire cores) and `ColorUVTranslate`/`DisplaceUVTranslate` (`_AsFire` paint) linearly and wraps them on loop boundaries. Speed = median step x 100 (the eye helpers' UV_HELPER_GAIN). Charmander/Charmeleon/Charizard: Blend0 (-0.30, 1.50), Blend1 (-0.45, 2.25), Mask0/1 (0, 1.50) UV/s, loop 6.667 s; Mega X its own; Skeledirge BodyC colour V 0.30, displace (-0.20, 0.20), loop 10 s. Viewer: UNITE silhouettes stay fixed; HOME's two noise layers scroll at those speeds and n = clamp((a+b)/p99) - mean shifts the colour ramp coordinate (user decision 2026-11-10: keep the approved colours on average). INFERRED: the layer combination (HOME's shader is not in the rip; the product, as in the static bake, left the core on 4% of the card = a red flame), the x100 gain and V sign for fire, and the V direction per mesh (`noiseDir`: noise travels root -> tip). Skeledirge's `_DISPOPE_SIN` displacement operator is not in the rip (recorded as `homeFire.displaceGap`, not drawn).

An FBX-only effect whose colour slot holds a grey tiling noise with near-solid alpha (>= 95% of texels > 0.95; noise_06 ships 0.973..1.0) and no silhouette in its block is a noise sheen: drawn additive at its grey value, never given the fire look (200 of 267 `*wenli*` scene JSON materials are additive noise/pattern Fx). White vertex colours take HOME's `_BaseColor`. Mega Charizard X battle/lobby wenli was an opaque cyan-white blob around the flames. Grey masks with near-solid alpha are their own alpha (was: alpha min >= 250).

entries.hypothesis: An effect texture drawn on fewer than 90% (SIBLING_COVERAGE) of a part's own UV samples is a streak/flicker overlay, not the part's colour: a same-name borrow is refused, and an FBX-only blended effect with such a texture is flagged `sparseTexture`; both go to home_parts, which replaces them only when the HOME match gates pass (else the texture stays). Skeledirge: battle flames `body_01_wzb` 2-4%, birds `lv3_02` 22-30%; footage shows solid flames. Noise sheens are exempt (a tiling noise covers everything).
